comment: The section says a model “inherits and amplifies” weaknesses in fragmented or poorly coded data. Models may amplify some weaknesses, mask others, or behave unpredictably; amplification is not automatic in every case.

anchor.note: p.105 l.Lines 40-50 read as the printed page; section 5.2 agrees

public.text: The section says a model “inherits and amplifies” weaknesses in fragmented or poorly coded data. Models may amplify some weaknesses, mask others, or behave unpredictably; amplification is not automatic in every case.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with a sentence like: “A model may reproduce, compound, or obscure weaknesses in the data, potentially at a scale that makes resulting errors difficult to detect and correct.”
